value: Near the entrance balcony of Blackrock Spire, Bodley appears only to one who can see ghosts. He had gone back toward the fortress and never returned. The quest giver fears he is dead; Bodley confirms it without ceremony and asks for help undoing the company’s wrong. If the top piece is already found, he can point toward the other two. His greeting is warm, even here, where the old danger began.
editorNote: Research status: the accessible quest and manual pages reproduce in-game evidence but are secondary mirrors. The manual is Bodley’s perspective. Alternate class/faction targets are editorially ordered and are not one canonical adventurer’s route.
